dct_title_s: Spain Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Oct 2024
dct_description_sm: # Spain Floods: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Oct 2024 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Spain Floods (Oct 2024) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Valencia Region, Spain, Floods, 1 Nov 2024, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Valencia Region, Spain, Floods, 31 Oct 2024 - 1 Nov 2024, v2.5 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Valencia Region, Spain, Floods, 31 Oct 2024, v0.9 ** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Valencia Region, Spain, Floods, 31 Oct 2024, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2024)
